meta.title: Turncoats and Incumbents in the 18th Lok Sabha
meta.source_label: Trivedi Centre for Political Data (TCPD), Ashoka University, Lok Dhaba
meta.methodology_note: TCPD assigns each electoral candidate since 1962 a Person ID (pid) via their own entity-resolution system, tracking whether they are an incumbent, a turncoat (switched party since their last contest), and how many prior terms they have served. TCPD's own data does not yet include the 2024 general election, so this page links each of the 484 sitting 18th Lok Sabha MPs, already verified on the Lok Sabha crime map, to their most recent TCPD-tracked election: Lok Sabha or state assembly, by matching name and state. Matches were only accepted where an MP's full name uniquely matched exactly one TCPD candidate in the same state, or, where several same-state candidates shared a name, exactly one whose constituency also matched. Every remaining case is marked "No linked prior-election record" rather than guessed. This includes both genuine first-time candidates and cases where TCPD's records exist under a different name spelling that this matching could not resolve.
